definitive_patches.specific_evidence: Every te'amim mark from line-closure-254 was checked against the actual s254 crops. Each has a visible mark on the right letter, above or below as expected: azla/qadma over the het of ובחדש and the tav of ועשיתם; geresh over the ayin of השביעי and the lamed of עלה; revia dot over the het of לחדש; double pashta on קדש and ניחח; zaqef (two dots) on the first לכם and on ליי; etnahta wedges under the sin of תעשו and the second אחד; silluq strokes in לכם: and תמימם:; conjunctive marks under אחד(1), מלאכת, לא, יום, יהיה(2), לריח, פר, בקר, איל, כבשים, שנה; tipha under עבדה, תרועה, אחד(2), שבעה. The metegs on מִֽקְרָא, תַֽעֲשׂוּ and לַֽיְיָ from line-closure-254 are left out until confirmed (see remaining questions). The marks under the patah of תעשו and ליי look like the lengthened patah bar that human396a read as having no meteg.
There is no dot inside the bet of בוא (row 2). In the same row, the bet of בְּהַשְׁלִיכִי does have its dagesh. This agrees with line-closure-258, whose patch was never applied.
There is a T-shaped qamats under the resh and no holam dot above or to the left of it. This agrees with line-closure-258, whose patch was never applied.
Row 2: under the lamed is a flat bar with no stem (patah). Under the mem is a qamats with a stem. This agrees with line-closure-262, whose patch was never applied.
Under the tet is a short bar with a stem (qamats), not two stacked dots. This agrees with line-closure-266, whose patch was never applied.
